title: CSS Containment Boundary Sandbox
description: Toggle contain: layout, paint, and size to observe live browser containing-block trapping, paint clipping, and intrinsic height collapse.
html:
Overflow (-16px)
Contained Subtree

This card holds normal flow text, a negative-offset badge, and a position: fixed chip.

position: fixed chip
js: var c = document.getElementById('card'); var r = document.getElementById('readout'); if (c && r) { var cs = getComputedStyle(c); var rect = c.getBoundingClientRect(); r.textContent = 'contain: ' + cs.contain + ' | computed box height: ' + Math.round(rect.height) + 'px'; }
expectedObservation: Enabling contain: layout traps the position: fixed chip inside the card. Enabling contain: paint clips the overflowing orange badge at the card's border box. Enabling contain: size causes the auto-height card to collapse as if it had zero children.
